result.description: Team chat/messaging app (Slack alternative) with free unlimited users, channels, DMs and integrations.
result.auth_detail: API addon generates a per-user API key (Api-Key header, per search snippet). Pumble Apps give app key + user/bot tokens (used as x-app-token and token headers on MCP). No documented public OAuth2 for third-party developers (OAuth2 on pricing page is SSO only).
result.access_detail: API key addon available on all plans, including Free; any Owner/Admin/Member can install and generate a key. Free plan caps connected apps/integrations at 3; unclear whether API addon counts toward it. Apps can be created from scratch in workspace settings.
result.api_notes: API-key REST (Swagger) covers send/reply/delete messages, reactions, create channel, list channel messages, list user's channels and DMs; 1000 req/min per user. Pumble Apps/SDK plus MCP expose ~20 scope-gated tools (search_messages, schedule_message, etc.). Swagger page not directly fetched, so endpoint count unverified.
result.blocker: No OAuth2 for third-party apps; auth is per-user API key or app key + user/bot tokens, so end users must generate credentials manually. API-key surface is narrow.

evidence.quote: This addon lets you generate an API key that allows you to send messages, reactions, and more via simple HTTP requests.
The x-app-token/xpat token is the **App key** you receive when you create an app from scratch.
The full list of available actions is available in the Swagger documentation.
The rate limit is up to 1000 requests per minute per user.
The list of available MCP tools is dynamic and depends entirely on the specific scopes you selected when creating an app.
